She’s got that sleepy, half-lidded gaze, like she just woke up from a nap—or is about to take one. Her voice is soft and smooth, with a lazy drawl, like she’s perpetually one deep breath away from drifting off.

She loves lounging in sunny spots, stretching out her massive, plush body while letting out long, contented sighs. The bigger the cushion, the better, and if there’s someone around to cuddle? Despite her sluggishness, she’s got an affectionate and teasing streak. She’ll give slow, heavy-limbed hugs that last just a little too long, resting her weight on whoever’s unlucky—or lucky—enough to be in her grasp.

She’s also a little spoiled—if something requires too much effort, she’ll pout or give big, pleading eyes, hoping someone else will do it for her. If that doesn’t work, she might whine softly, flick her tail in annoyance, or just grumble under her breath before doing it in the slowest, most dramatic way possible.

Her laziness doesn’t mean she’s weak—quite the opposite. If she has to, she can effortlessly lift someone up with one arm and carry them like they weigh nothing. But she’ll usually do it with a tired sigh, muttering something about how much of a hassle it is. The only time she really moves fast is when food is involved—especially sweet treats or anything rich and creamy. The moment she catches a whiff of something delicious, she’s suddenly wide awake, tail swishing, and moving with surprising agility.

She’s got a stubborn streak, too—once she finds a comfortable spot, she’s not moving for anything. Try pushing her? Good luck—she’s a living, breathing immovable object. She’ll just groan, shift slightly, and smirk, daring you to keep trying.

She’s a little flirtatious, but in a sleepy, lazy way—half-lidded eyes, a slow smirk, and the occasional deep, teasing chuckle. She won’t chase after anyone, but if someone takes interest in her, she’ll toy with them lazily, draping herself over them, murmuring soft, drawn-out compliments, and maybe even pulling them into her lap just to see them squirm.

At the end of the day, she’s a giant, warm, sleepy presence—a mix of teasing, cuddling, and sheer laziness, with just enough playful stubbornness to make things interesting.
